events.title: 사우샘프턴 make it five league wins in a row by beating 에버턴 1–0 at Goodison Park. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are now 11 points adrift of safety after losing 3–0 to 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane, with 게리 리네커 scoring a hat-trick. A Second Division promotion crunch game at Filbert Street sees 레스터 시티 beat 미들즈브러 2–1.
윔블던 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 3–0 at Selhurst Park , meaning that they now only need five points from their final six games to be sure of survival and a place in the Premier League.
노샘프턴 타운 go into receivership with debts of £1million; the club's administrators sack manager Theo Foley .

리즈 유나이티드's title challenge suffers another blow as they lose 4–0 to 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road . Luton keep their survival hopes alive with a 2–1 home win over 윔블던, cutting the gap between themselves and 19th-placed Coventry to five points. 애스턴 빌라 manage an impressive 5–2 away win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are pushed closer to relegation with a 2–1 defeat at 첼시. 사우샘프턴 beat QPR 2–1 to make it six league wins a row. Cambridge move back into the Second Division automatic promotion places at the expense of 블랙번 로버스 by beating 밀월 1–0 at home.

선덜랜드 beat 노리치 시티 1–0 to reach their first FA Cup final since 1973, while 포츠머스 draw 1–1 after extra time with 리버풀, whose manager Graeme Souness is rushed to hospital just hours after the game to undergo an emergency heart operation.

라이언 긱스 scores against 맨체스터 시티 in the Manchester derby at Old Trafford for the second season running, but this time United fail to take all the points as their neighbours hold them to a 1–1 draw. With six games left to play, United now have a two-point lead over Leeds and a game in hand. 노츠 카운티 slide closer to relegation with a 2–0 home defeat to 토트넘 홋스퍼.

셰필드 웬즈데이's title bid is effectively ended when they are held to a goalless draw at Coventry, whose two dropped points are a gift to 20th-placed Luton, who are now six points adrift of Don Howe's team and have a game in hand. 윔블던 climb four places to 10th with a 3–2 win over 리버풀 at Anfield, 아스널 win 3–1 over 노리치 시티 at Carrow Road, and 사우샘프턴's six-match winning run ends with a 1–0 home defeat to 노팅엄 포리스트. 레스터 시티 reach fifth place in the race for places in the new Premier League by beating 선덜랜드 3–2 at Filbert Street – a result which leaves the FA Cup finalists on the brink of the relegation zone, although they have games in hand over all of the bottom three teams.

Paul Merson scores a hat-trick in 아스널's 4–1 home win over 크리스털 팰리스. 리즈 유나이티드 beat 첼시 3–0 to move one point ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the league, although 알렉스 퍼거슨's men still have two games in hand. 노츠 카운티 beat Coventry 1–0 to keep their survival hopes alive, but still need at least seven points from their final four games to stand any chance of avoiding relegation. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 beat 노리치 시티 4–0 at Upton Park to give themselves fresh hope of survival, they are still nine points adrift to safety with six games left to play but have two games in hand over 19th-placed Coventry. Luton failed to take advantage of Coventry's latest defeat, crashing to a 5–1 defeat at Oldham in which Graeme Sharp scored four goals. At the top of the Second Division, 입스위치 타운 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 3–2 at Portman Road and will guarantee their place in the new Premier League if they pick up as little as five points from their last five games. Cambridge hold on to second place despite a 2–1 defeat at 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 레스터 시티 keep their automatic promotion hopes alive with a 3–1 home win over 반즐리. 블랙번 로버스's dismal run of form continues as they lose 2–1 at 왓퍼드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 노팅엄 포리스트 1–0 in the League Cup final thanks to a Brian McClair goal in the first half.
리버풀 defeat 포츠머스 on penalties after their FA Cup semi-final replay ends in a goalless draw.

Luton are now just three points adrift of safety after beating 노팅엄 포리스트 2–1 at Kenilworth Road. 셰필드 유나이티드 peak in eighth place with a 2–0 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at Bramall Lane . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 lose 1–0 at home to 사우샘프턴, who are now almost certainly safe from relegation, but 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are left needing at least nine points from their final four games to stand any chance of avoiding relegation.

On the third anniversary of the Hillsborough disaster, Graeme Souness sparks outrage when he gives an exclusive front page interview with The Sun newspaper, which is still reviled on Merseyside following its controversial reporting of the tragedy in which 95 리버풀 fans died, celebrating his recovery from heart surgery and 리버풀's victory in the FA Cup semi-final. On the Football League scene, there is no action in the First Division but 미들즈브러 clinch three vital points in the Second Division promotion race with a 2–1 win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and 더비 카운티 win 2–1 at Brighton, with both results impacting on the promotion and relegation issues.
맨체스터 유나이티드 return to the top of the First Division when an Andrei Kanchelskis goal gives them a 1–0 home win over 사우샘프턴 and a two-point lead over Leeds, with the advantage of a game in hand.

케임브리지 유나이티드 squander the chance of bouncing back into the Second Division automatic promotion places when they are held to a 2–2 draw at home to 포츠머스, whose own playoff push takes a major blow by the failure to win the game.

리버풀 hold 리즈 유나이티드 to a goalless draw at Anfield . 맨체스터 유나이티드 fail to take advantage as they can only manage a 1–1 draw at 루턴 타운, but remain two points clear at the top with a game in hand. The point equally was crucial for Luton, who are now just two points adrift of safety due to Coventry's 1–0 defeat at home to 에버턴. 셰필드 웬즈데이 win 1–0 at 사우샘프턴 and are still in with a faint chance of winning the league title just one season after promotion. 노츠 카운티 claw back to being four points adrift of safety with a 1–0 win at 노리치 시티, who suddenly find themselves in danger of relegation after a recent slump in league form.
Defender Mick McCarthy becomes player-manager of 밀월 following the sacking of Bruce Rioch .

Ian Wright scores twice as 아스널 beat 리버풀 4–0 at Highbury. 리즈 유나이티드 are one point ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드, who have a game in hand, after a 2–0 home win over relegation threatened 코번트리 시티, while 알렉스 퍼거슨 's team lose 2–1 at home to 노팅엄 포리스트. 셰필드 웬즈데이 maintain their slim chance of snatching the title by recording a third straight victory, and are now just three points off top spot. 웨스트햄 유나이티드's relegation is almost certain following a 2–0 home defeat to 크리스털 팰리스, meaning that they will have to win their final three games of the season and hope that Coventry lose their remaining three games to survive even on goal difference. Luton squander their chance to climb out of the drop zone with a 2–1 defeat at QPR, while 노츠 카운티's 3–1 defeat at home to 셰필드 유나이티드 leaves them needing to win both of their remaining games to stand any chance of survival. In the Second Division, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 have fallen back into the relegation zone and their 4–1 defeat at 더비 카운티 is a big boost for their hosts in the push for promotion.

Businessman Max Griggs forms a new team, Rushden & Diamonds , from a merger of Rushden Town and Irthlingborough Diamonds, to play in the Midland Division of the Southern League next season. In the Second Division, 입스위치 타운's promotion celebrations are put on hold when they are held to a goalless draw at home by Grimsby, but their now just need a single point from their final two games to guarantee promotion. 레스터 시티's automatic promotion hopes are given a major boost by a 2–1 home win over Cambridge, which ends John Beck 's team's hopes of automatic promotion, although they remain in the playoff places and in contention for a unique third successive promotion. Charlton edge 블랙번 로버스 out of the playoff places on goal difference with a 1–1 draw at 포트 베일 , who would have climbed out of the relegation zone with a victory.

맨체스터 유나이티드's title hopes are left hanging by a thread when they lose 1–0 to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park. They remain one point behind leaders 리즈 유나이티드 with two games remaining. The victory also delays 웨스트햄 유나이티드's almost certain relegation.

Newly promoted clubs 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 노츠 카운티 are both relegated from the First Division. County's relegation is confirmed by a 2–0 defeat to 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road, and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are beaten 1–0 at Coventry, who stay out of the relegation zone despite Luton's 2–0 win over 애스턴 빌라. 셰필드 웬즈데이 miss the chance to go level with 리즈 유나이티드 at the top as they draw 1–1 with 크리스털 팰리스. 입스위치 타운 become the first team to win promotion to the new Premier League when they draw 1–1 at 옥스퍼드 유나이티드, which also seals them the Second Division title. 레스터 시티 would have gone into their final game needing just a point to achieve promotion had they managed to win at Charlton, but found themselves on the receiving end of a 2–0 defeat and also face the prospect of being pipped to automatic promotion by their local rivals 더비 카운티, who won 2–1 at 브리스틀 시티. 블랙번 로버스 beat 밀월 2–1 at Ewood Park but remain one place outside the playoff places due to Charlton's win. 미들즈브러 beat 브리스틀 로버스 2–1 at Ayresome Park and will go into their final game of the season in the automatic places on goal difference if they win their game in hand. 포트 베일's 4–2 defeat at Cambridge leaves them needing to win their final game to stand any chance of survival.

리즈 유나이티드 are confirmed as league champions for the first time in eighteen years, and just two years after winning promotion, thanks to a 3–2 win over 셰필드 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–0 defeat at 리버풀 immediately afterwards.
FA Cup finalists 선덜랜드 secure their Second Division survival with a goalless draw over Swindon at Roker Park .

After guiding 선덜랜드 to the FA Cup final and Second Division survival, Malcolm Crosby receives the manager's job on a permanent basis. 미들즈브러 move into second place in the Second Division with a 2–0 home win over Grimsby. Charlton lose 1–0 at home to Tranmere to give 블랙번 로버스 the advantage of their game in hand in the race for a playoff place.

블랙번 로버스 climb back into the top six of the Second Division on goal difference with a 2–2 draw over 선덜랜드 at Ewood Park. Brighton keep their survival hopes alive with a 2–1 home win over 포츠머스, whose playoff hopes are ended as a result.

입스위치 타운 have sealed promotion to the new Premier League as Second Division champions, ending six years outside the top flight. 레스터 시티 now occupy the second automatic promotion place, but face competition from 더비 카운티 and 미들즈브러. 케임브리지 유나이티드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 complete the top six.
